title: Remediate @sevenpico/cdk-construct-slackbot — JSII standalone function exports
description:
slackbot-fns.ts exports standalone functions (topicContext, lambdaContext, etc.) from the package index. These will fail JSII multi-language packaging because JSII does not support standalone exported functions — only classes, interfaces, and enums.

Fix: remove standalone function re-exports from index.ts (keep functions as internal module-level only, referenced by the construct but not exported publicly). Or wrap in a namespace class if public access is needed.

Flagged as non-blocking advisory by code-reviewer during PR #70 review.
